packages.name: 40-K Meltagun
packages.description: Sets ergonomics to 40.

packages.name: A/GM-17 Gas Mortar Sentry
packages.description: Sets sentry health to 600.

packages.name: AC-8 Autocannon Backpackless Rework
packages.description: The AC-8 call-in delivers only the Autocannon, leaving the backpack slot free. It holds 10 loaded rounds and 60 reserve rounds, self-reloads with its familiar five-round top clips while walking, and reloads about 20% faster. A resupply can refill up to 60 reserve rounds. Ergonomics rises from 17 to 30. Horizontal and vertical recoil drift fall from 200/450 to 150/337.5, and horizontal and vertical recoil climb fall from 2/100 to 1.5/75 (25% less recoil in each value). APHET direct damage rises from 325/260 to 375/340 normal/durable, direct armor penetration rises from AP4 to AP5, and impact explosion normal damage rises from 150 to 180. FLAK explosion normal damage rises from 190 to 210 and outer blast radius from 7 to 8 metres; its parent round and shrapnel are unchanged. JAR-5 Dominator High Explosive ammunition shares that explosion and receives the same explosion damage and radius increase.

packages.name: APW-1 Anti-Materiel Rifle
packages.description: Sets ergonomics to 40.

packages.name: AR-11 Arbitrator
packages.description: Sets rifle damage to 80 and magazine capacity to 65 rounds. Sets underbarrel starting and maximum spare ammo to 30, stagger force to 25, and push force to 20. Its shotgun magazine holds 4 shells and refills 20 shells. Base ergonomics is 41, giving 40 with the default optic.

packages.name: AR-32 Pacifier Tuning
packages.description: AR-32 Pacifier bullets deal 75 normal and 15 durable damage, build Stun Medium at strength 3 per hit, and its default magazine holds 65 rounds. Weapon sway is 0.6.

packages.name: ARC-12 Blitzer
packages.description: Sets normal damage to 100, durable damage to 45, arc range to 30 m, and fire rate to 80 RPM.

packages.name: ARC-3 Rapid/Supercharge
packages.description: ARC-3 offers Auto/Rapid and Semi/Supercharge. Rapid charges in 0.307692/0.338462/0.369231 seconds and deals approximately 192.1 normal / 76.5 durable damage. Supercharge charges in 3.4/3.5/3.75 seconds, deals 2325 normal / 2325 durable damage, targets one enemy, and cannot explode from overcharge. Both modes have AP7, 45 m reach and stock ARC audio.

packages.name: CQC-20 Breaching Hammer
packages.description: Sets direct-hit, slight-blast, and large-blast armor penetration to 7. Sets starting, resupply, and maximum magazine counts to 21 each.

packages.name: Gas Overhaul
packages.description: Gas weapons apply 15-second temporary armor reduction. Shared gas normal/durable damage is 45/45 DPS; Sterilizer capacity is 175 rounds, gas/confusion buildup is 0.75, and incoming Helldiver gas damage multiplier is 0.7333. Can be used alongside ARC-3 Rapid/Supercharge v0.14. Can be used alongside SAI Focus Precision v0.10.

packages.name: One True Flag
packages.description: Configurable normal damage from 0 to 9999, default 300. Durable damage is half of normal (rounded down) or equal to normal; default 150.

packages.name: P-34 Breacher
packages.description: Sets the magazines received from resupply to 2.

packages.name: PLAS-1 Scorcher AR
packages.description: Increases the magazine from 20 to 50 rounds and fire rate from 350 to 540 RPM. Reduces normal damage from 200 total to 150: 75 impact plus 75 explosion, before armor, hit location and distance falloff. Sets impact durable damage to 38 and explosion durable damage to 75 (113 combined against fully durable targets). Increases the full-damage blast radius from 1 to 1.25 metres and outer blast radius from 2 to 2.5 metres. Starting spare magazines increase from 3 to 4, and maximum spare magazines from 5 to 6; resupply grants 5 magazines. Uses the Scorcher's native Semi and Auto selector. Select Auto in Weapon Functions for continuous fire; at 540 RPM, a 50-round magazine provides approximately 5.56 seconds of sustained fire. Reduces horizontal/vertical recoil drift from 20 to 15, horizontal camera recoil from 2 to 1.5, and vertical camera recoil from 20 to 15 (25% less per shot).

packages.name: PLAS-39 Accelerator Rifle
packages.description: Magazine capacity is 21 rounds. Horizontal and vertical recoil drift and camera recoil are 2, horizontal and vertical spread are 0.3, sway is 0.4, and stagger is 25. Direct-hit and blast armor penetration are 4, and outer blast and shockwave radii are 2.5 m. Semi fires one round with a 0.01-second minimum charge at a base rate of 200 RPM (0.30-second spacing). Burst fires three rounds, consumes three rounds, charges for at least 0.45 seconds and spaces its rounds 0.12 seconds apart. Both modes use normal firing audio. Fixes PLAS-39 Semi/Burst switching and firing audio when the game applies its fire-rate modifier. Both modes retain that modifier and follow the selected Weapon Functions mode.

packages.name: PLAS-45 Epoch Highest-Charge Rework
packages.description: PLAS-45 Epoch highest-charge shots gain 30% more normal and durable direct-hit and blast damage, burning on blast hits, a 5 m full-damage radius, 6 m outer damage radius and 7 m shockwave radius. Magazine capacity increases from 3 to 4 rounds and maximum spare magazines from 4 to 5. Reload while walking with the existing reload animation.

packages.name: R/40-K Hot-Shot
packages.description: Sets magazine capacity to 20 rounds, starting magazines to 5, resupply magazines to 5, maximum magazines to 5, and ergonomics to 45. Uses standard magazine reloads.

packages.name: RS-422 Railgun
packages.description: Sets durable damage to 240.

packages.name: S-11 Speargun
packages.description: Sets starting magazines to 16, resupply magazines to 10, maximum magazines to 20, and ergonomics to 40.

packages.name: SAI Focus Precision
packages.description: LAS-12 SAI deals 90 normal and 21 durable damage at the muzzle with either lens. Standard Lens spread is 70 MRAD and Focus Lens spread is 37.5 MRAD on both axes, each 50% below stock. Both lenses fire at 900 RPM. Projectile launch speed is 1,300 m/s and drag is 1.244, adding damage loss over distance. Recoil is reduced by one-third with both lenses. Heat per shot is reduced by one-third: 2 to 1.333333 with Standard and cooldown heatsinks, or 1.5 to 1 with the heat-capacity heatsink.

packages.name: Sickle Laser AR
packages.description: LAS-16 Sickle deals 70 normal and 10 durable damage and generates 50% less heat per shot, from 1.15 to 0.575. LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle deals 65/10 normal/durable damage cold and warm, then 83/14 at hot and maximum heat. Both weapons have at least AP3 penetration; Double-Edge reaches AP4 at maximum heat. Both Sickles have a base fire rate of 700 RPM, zero horizontal and vertical spread, and 2,000 m/s projectiles at every heat tier with no distance damage fall-off. Double-Edge direct heat self-damage is reduced by 25%. Its heat buildup, cooling and maximum-heat ignition remain unchanged; general fire damage is unchanged.

packages.name: Tenderizer Armor Softener
packages.description: AR-61 Tenderizer magazine capacity increases from 35 to 70 rounds and bullet launch speed from 820 to 1,000 m/s. Direct and slight-angle armor penetration increase from AP2 to AP3; the other angle settings remain unchanged. Bullets apply Acid Storm to temporarily reduce enemy armor effectiveness for 15 seconds. Base sway is set to 0.9. Normal/durable damage is 90/30, with the existing 600/850 RPM settings, recoil and spread. The shared Acid Storm duration also affects its weather effect after exposure ends.

packages.name: VG-70 Variable Portable Maxigun Rework
packages.option: Enable VG-70 Variable Portable Maxigun Rework
packages.description: The primary-slot VG-70 Variable keeps its mobile, backpack-free reload and gains a 150-round magazine. Auto offers 550, 750 and 1,000 RPM, with 110/29, 90/24 and 75/20 normal/durable damage per bullet, AP3. Volley fires 15 simultaneous bullets at 40/11 damage each, AP3, following the selected native RPM. Total fires all remaining rounds at 28/8 damage per bullet, AP3, with spread reduced to 0.75 on both axes. The weapon keeps 6 starting spare magazines, up to 7 maximum and 7 per resupply, along with its existing reload, projectile speed and sound. Recoil is reduced by 15% in every mode: drift 4.25/8.5 and climb 3.4/6.8 horizontal/vertical. Base ergonomics is 40 and sway is 0.9. Total retains its stock right-arm self-injury and knockdown behavior. Sustained Auto muzzle flashes stay aligned.

packages.name: BR-14 Adjudicator Heavy Battle Rifle
packages.option: Enable BR-14 Adjudicator Heavy Battle Rifle
packages.description: BR-14 Adjudicator becomes a heavy battle rifle: normal/durable damage rises from 95/23 to 115/30, stagger force from 15 to 25, and push force becomes 10 instead of 12. Magazine capacity increases from 30 to 48 rounds. Fire rate falls from 550 to 480 RPM. Bullet velocity rises from 820 to 1,000 m/s, and speed loss per penetration falls from 25% to 15%. Horizontal recoil drift becomes 16.5 instead of 17, vertical recoil drift rises from 35 to 57.5, and base sway falls from 1 to 0.6. Existing armor penetration, recoil climb, spread, drag and spare-magazine counts are retained.

candidate_description: Restores VG-70 Variable Auto, Volley and Total to their intended damage, with AP3 medium penetration in every mode. Includes 23 independent weapon/equipment switches and the unchanged 29 One True Flag presets.
